metadata.description: Operational Claude Code skills that replace abstract principles with mechanical rules — fixing quality oscillation in code review, design, and architecture.

plugins.name: solid
plugins.description: Engineering discipline cross-language: SOLID + TDD + clean code + refactoring + design patterns + architecture + code review + legacy code + when-not-to-apply. 14 operational references with mechanical tells, decision trees, and Fowler-style refactor recipes. Examples in TypeScript; rules universal across OO languages.

plugins.name: vanilla-js-architect
plugins.description: Designs and implements browser-side SDKs, libraries, and frameworks in vanilla JavaScript. Architecture, encapsulation, distribution (ESM/UMD/IIFE), and cross-runtime support (browsers, Workers, Deno, Bun, Cloudflare Workers). Modern primitives: AbortSignal.any/timeout, Symbol.dispose/using, structuredClone. Ships .d.ts via JSDoc.

plugins.name: release-hardening-audit
plugins.description: Pre-publish security hardening audit for JavaScript / TypeScript / Node.js projects. Catches non-obvious release-blocking issues that traditional code review misses: sourcemap leakage on CDN, build-time env-var inlining of server secrets, npm publish surface drift (`files` field gaps, `.d.ts` internal leaks), postinstall risks in transitive deps, GitHub Actions privilege escalation, OIDC vs long-lived `NPM_TOKEN`. Surface-aware: adapts Express idioms (helmet, CORS, cookies, body limits, trust proxy) to AWS Lambda + API Gateway, Cloudflare Workers, Next.js, and standalone Node `http.createServer`. Handles monorepo umbrellas (workspaces, lerna, simple subproject co-location). Complements PR-level vulnerability scanning by focusing on hardening gaps in the shipped artifact rather than code-level vulnerabilities.
